correctness.rationale: The projection has an explicit section. With q=s∘τ∘π, both id_B→q and s∘π→q are valid one-step homotopies because every fiber-to-successor-fiber arc is present. Thus π and s are homotopy inverses. For directed cycles, the successor map supplies τ; a direct chain calculation gives one integral H1 generator and Ω_k=0 for k≥2. The bundled verifier independently checks the map/homotopy conditions on 53 exhaustive small-base instances and recomputes H0 and H1 on nonuniform cycle blow-ups.

value.rationale: Complete vertex blow-ups are a standard graph construction and can enlarge every path-chain group dramatically. The theorem gives a reusable structural condition under which all of that enlargement is homotopically inessential, with an explicit two-step witness rather than a case-by-case homology computation. The directed-cycle corollary turns an infinite family of dense cyclic layer networks into a single base computation and illustrates why the criterion is useful.
